question: Anaya has to reach Hyderabad which is 574 km away in 18 hours. His starting speed for 11 hours was 36 km/hr. For the next 136 km his speed was 34 km/hr. By what speed he must travel now so as to reach Hyderabad in the decided time of 18 hours?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance = 574 km and Total time = 18 hours.

Distance covered in first two parts = (36 × 11) + 136 = 396 + 136 = 532 km.

Time taken in first two parts = 11 + (136 ÷ 34) = 11 + 4 = 15 hours.

Remaining distance = 574 − 532 = 42 km and Remaining time = 18 − 15 = 3 hours.

Required speed for remaining part = 42 ÷ 3 = 14 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 14 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 

 Total Distance = 574 km (18 hours)
